map.印花税（本页代码口径）：税额=凭证金额×税率（税率按百分数÷100）；联动量：含: Stamp duty (code basis on this page): tax = document amount × rate (rate as a percentage ÷ 100); linked values: amount including tax = amount × (1+rate), reciprocal of the rate = 1÷max(rate, 10⁻¹²), tax back-calculated from the tax-inclusive price = amount × rate ÷ (1+rate). Validation: no strict validation, empty values fall back to 0. Rule: no fixed grading; tax is linearly related to the document amount, and the back-calculation item splits the tax base when the tax-inclusive total is known.
